text:
Alex G: Heads up — after the per-key enforcement rollout a couple internal-service keys started getting 429s during nightly ETL backfills. Need a short-term plan for safe, auditable overrides.

Maria L: saw the alerts, linked the traces. Most are steady bursts from legacy worker pools that were never migrated to the batching client. Not malicious.

Kevin H: can we do a temporary "soft-limit" that lets requests through but still emits a metric + alert if usage exceeds X%? Less blast radius than removing limits.

Judy P: Agree. UX idea: Console -> Key details -> "Temporary override" with: reason, owner, TTL, max-burst, audit checkbox. Defaults: TTL=24h, max-burst=2x baseline. Owner must be a person.

Sam (platform): Implementation notes: backend support = add override record keyed by api_key + scope. Enforcement flow: check override before hard cap, allow request but tag event with override_id. Also emit audit_event and increment metric quota.override.used.

Alex G: Also need CLI/API to create overrides for automation (ops runbooks). Example proposal for API:

```
PUT /internal-keys/{key}/overrides
{ "reason": "backfill ETL", "owner": "alex.g@redwood.com", "ttl_secs": 86400, "burst_multiplier": 2 }
```

Response should include override_id + expires_at.

Maria L: Important: every override must create an immutable audit record (who, when, justification) and appear in the key's timeline in console. No exceptions.

Kevin H: Telemetry we need: per-key 429_rate_before_override, 429_rate_during_override, qps, token_count, and a flaggable metric if override masks an underlying inefficiency for >48h.

Judy P: For rollout: feature-flag UI and API, enable for internal orgs only, then partner support. Canary on staging -> internal -> partners. Add a guard: max 7d TTL for self-service overrides; >7d needs eng-platform review.

Sam (platform): I'll add enforcement hook + event schema. Also propose a circuit-breaker: if error rate or latency worsens when override active, automatically revoke and notify owner.

Ops Sheriff: add SLO implications to alerts. If many overrides active for same org, page oncall.

Alex G: Also want a lightweight backfill flow that adds override + creates a temporary billing note (so finance isn't surprised). Could be optional flag create_billing_note=true.

Maria L: We should also add a cleanup job to surface expiring overrides in Console 48h/2h/10m before expiry.

Judy P: I'll mock up console screens — one with a small "Temporary override" modal and another timeline view. Will attach in design channel.

Sam (platform): I'll implement API + DB schema. We should reuse existing audit table and add an override_id index.

Kevin H: For tests: unit tests for lookup order (override wins over hard cap), e2e at load, and a chaos test that revokes mid-backfill.

quota-bot: Override created by Alex G for key svc-internal-42 expires in 24h (override_id: ovr_20230301_01) :white_check_mark:

Alex G: Thanks team. Next actions: Judy mockups, Sam API PR by EOD Thu, Kevin write e2e test, Maria add telemetry dashboard + baseline query. I'll follow up with the partner owners to confirm timing. :thumbsup:
